Journey: Peter and John's Journey to Samaria
Summary: When the apostles at Jerusalem heard Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John, who prayed for the new believers to receive the Holy Spirit and preached in many Samaritan villages on the way back. The text names no villages on the return.
Significance: Peter and John's visit seals the Samaritan mission: the Spirit falls beyond Jerusalem's old boundaries.
